test_title: PYST 155: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 06 Feb, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: O, P, Q, R and S are sitting on a circular table facing towards the centre. R is sitting to the immediate left of S. Q is sitting to the immediate right of O. S is the immediate neighbour of R and O. P is sitting to the immediate left of R. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Q?
solution:
The sitting arrangement as per the given information:

1. R is sitting to the immediate left of S and S is the immediate neighbour of R and O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f12974da8e6e391891891f15c24aa312833a5b73a04633ed02f8e50afc5596e7.png] 

2. Q is sitting to the immediate right of O and the remaining P is sitting to the immediate left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea6967be566c525a9725ecfe617d4d1cdc774761409dc9956892ef63f41b75ca.png] 

Here,** 'P' **is sitting to the immediate right of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
